name: record.js file script
how: A file in the app's frontend folder, found by the build
changes: Handlers on a doctype's record page

name: Stored script
how: A Client Script row with view = Record
changes: Handlers on a doctype's record page

name: list.js list file
how: A file in the app's frontend folder
changes: A doctype's list, such as extra columns

name: item.js item file
how: A file in the app's frontend folder
changes: How one kind of navigation item draws
pairNote: Winner rule differs today: first app wins the renderer, last app wins the visibility hook

name: App page
how: A page file the build registers
changes: Adds a page under the app's prefix

name: Replacement page (pages.json)
changes: Replaces the standard list or record page for a doctype

name: @shell import alias
changes: Desk names an app file may import
pairNote: Two import lists; the target has one

name: import_map hook
changes: Names a stored script may import
pairNote: Two import lists; the target has one

name: desk.package.json
changes: The app's frontend packages

name: Tailwind preset
how: A preset file in the app
changes: The app's theme

name: app_prefix hook
changes: The address prefix the app claims

name: app_modular hook
changes: Whether record addresses include the module

name: app_permission hook
changes: Who may enter the app's prefix

name: app_boot hook
changes: Extra keys in the boot payload

name: add_to_apps_screen hook
changes: The app's tile on /apps

name: navigation_item_resolvers hook
changes: Who can see the app's own item type

name: Cross-app rail rows (app:key)
how: Navigation rows shipped by another app
changes: Adds rows to another app's rail

name: Base rail and sidebars
how: Rail and Sidebar records shipped with the app
changes: The app's navigation

name: Site rail and sidebar copy
how: Rail and Sidebar site layer, or the customize dialog
changes: Navigation for every user on the site

name: Form Layout
changes: Details, Side Panel or Quick Entry layout
pairNote: A field can be hidden three ways: the layout, a script, or the DocType

name: Doctype View (site)
how: The list's column and sort panels, saved for the site
changes: Default columns, sort and quick filters

name: DocType and Customize Form
changes: Fields, labels, hidden, read-only

name: Doctype View (user)
how: The list's column and sort panels
changes: The user's own columns, sort and quick filters

name: Arrangement (user)
changes: The user's order of rail and sidebar items

name: Per-user rail and sidebar
changes: Rows the user hides or adds
